name: Clinical / Biological Specimen
publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: the bounded Claude Sonnet and Grok attempts timed out before producing admissible results; no external result was admitted.

Boundary hold: source organisms, people, environments, places, body sites, procedures, devices, containers, repositories, requests, observations, analyses, results, datasets, consents, permits, agreements and decisions remain external masters.
Identity hold: every specimen requires stable physical identity; accessions, barcodes, labels, containers, positions, timestamps and digital rows are not universal material identity.
Profile hold: human clinical, veterinary, plant, microbial, environmental, biodiversity, food, tumor, liquid-biopsy, tissue, cell, nucleic-acid and other profiles require specialist review.
Quality hold: fitness, integrity, contamination, quantity and sufficiency require method, units, time, uncertainty, threshold and intended-use qualification.
Licensed-standard hold: ISO and ISBER detail is licensed or advisory; production conformance must use authorized copies and exact releases.
Rights hold: consent or lawful basis, permits, MTA, Nagoya applicability, benefit sharing, purpose, jurisdiction and withdrawal rules require accountable review.
Safety hold: infectious, toxic, radioactive, genetically modified, dangerous-goods and biosecurity profiles require applicable specialist controls.
Interoperability hold: source and target releases, mapping direction, transformation, inference, omissions and round-trip loss must be declared for every projection.
Completeness hold: the 24-source draft is broad but does not claim universal specimen, laboratory, biobank, biodiversity, legal, safety or operational coverage.
Independent external review was explicitly waived by the repository owner; this codex-only result remains a reviewable draft.
